typographie_suggestion.explanation: The typeface features the high contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and small, unbracketed serifs characteristic of the "Modern" or Didone style (similar to Bodoni or Didot), which was the standard for formal French printing in the mid-19th century.
